displayScope: One direct Gossamer arc-chain prototype cast; actual entities within 20 blocks of scene; sequential queries are not an atomic tick snapshot
review: 通過後に位置を変えず敵側へ向き直ることを実機映像と座標・角度記録で確認。刀の表示期間の重なりを解消。箱状残像、刀の曲率、途切れる細い縁、白い帯状残光、花模様、腕姿勢、カメラは未一致。通常入力・状態分岐・正式キット対応は未確定。
implementation: Existing zero-distance dash with local_direction -Z and face_movement turns at tick25 without sweep or immunity. Remove compensating180deg tilt from later rigs. Separate held-weapon rig windows: ready0..6, horizontal7..13, rise14..22, arrive25..29, return30..38, recovery39..53.
rejected: First capture confirmed turn but showed2 solid weapon rigs during overlapping windows; shortened horizontal/arrive lifetimes and delayed recovery, then recaptured.
limits: Fixed180deg turn follows this observed crossing, not arbitrary live target movement. No general live-facing feature added. Four damage events remain a prototype timing fixture.
